thread:
emma: opened a PR to refresh SDK snippets (streaming, retries, pagination) across py/ts/go. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4323
raj: quick q — what changed in the pagination example?
emma: swapped limit/offset to cursor-based paginator, added cursor token example + edge-case note about repeated empty pages. also unified retry backoff pseudo-code across languages.
mike: can you add an AbortController example for the TS streaming cancel case? customers run into long tails.
emma: yup will add. also replaced the broken pagination RFC link.
sofia: do we need to backport this to stable/v1.9? some Dedicated customers rely on old docs
raj: yes, please cherrypick after merge. I'll own the go backport if needed.
emma: splitting work — i'll handle python generator updates + tests, mike takes ts streaming/cancellation, raj handles go examples and context cancellation usage.
docs-bot: deploy preview queued for PR #4323 :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
mike: small nit — for TS prefer `for await (const chunk of stream)` since SDK yields an async iterable
emma: good call, switching to for-await and adding AbortController snippet
raj: for Go example, show `context.WithTimeout` + streaming loop reading from io.Reader, and a small helper that converts channel->stream.
sofia: QA request — include a tiny pytest that mocks responses so examples run in CI without an API key
emma: added `examples/tests/test_snippets.py` with a simple mocked stream generator and assertions
mike: tested TS snippet locally; one tweak: `stream.close()` -> `controller.abort()`; left PR comment
emma: addressed comments, pushed changes, preview: https://deploy-preview-4323--docs.redwood.ai :eyeglasses: 
docs-bot: preview deploy successful — https://deploy-preview-4323--docs.redwood.ai :white_check_mark:
mike: approved and left a thumbs up :+1:
sofia: good job. I'll write a short note for support to point customers to the updated examples and mention the pagination link fix
